current_research_objective: Scientific validation remains at 98%. Frozen B1a is characterized but unstable across meetings. A separately preregistered NL1 replacement architecture was selected on DEVELOPMENT_ONLY evidence, then failed its untouched five-meeting validation on the preregistered pooled-log-loss and meeting-stability gates despite improving Top1 and Top3. NL1 is therefore not promoted and must not be retuned from that validation. The immediate owner-free priority is to preregister and test a new stability-oriented DEVELOPMENT_ONLY lineage using only exposed non-protected evidence, then reserve a fresh collision-audited meeting-disjoint validation universe. DEV2000 remains restricted diagnostic/reproducibility evidence and ECON_HOLDOUT1000 remains sealed.

scientific_findings.b1a: Frozen B1a contains broad ranking information but exhibits material meeting/regime variation. Formula drift is ruled out. Simple venue, exact-circumference, normalized-entropy, top1-margin and meeting-day repair rules are not validated.
scientific_findings.nl1: The unanchored linear-softmax NL1 showed large DEVELOPMENT_ONLY LOMO improvement but did not reproduce the required log-loss gain or meeting stability on fresh untouched meetings. Top1 and Top3 improved on the untouched sample, so some ranking signal may be useful, but the architecture is not scientifically validated.
scientific_findings.required_next_design_property: Prioritize cross-meeting stability and calibration with a separately preregistered lower-variance/anchored architecture. No post-hoc NL1 repair counts as confirmation.

immutable_rule_summary: Historical virtual-world simulation is the primary path until final live confirmation (KR-016).
Offline simulation does not require live odds unless an experiment specifically tests odds.
Results/payouts remain separated from predictor inputs and predictions are frozen before dedicated scoring.
Exact circumference is preserved; no nearest-length coercion.
No guessed PRE fields, post-result cherry-picking, confirmatory retune, or unfavorable-case deletion.
GitHub is canonical continuity state; chat is ephemeral.
Runtime and automatic betting remain OFF.

latest_completed_experiments.result: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY: 320 labelled races, 11 meetings. NL1_NUMERIC_CLASS_STYLE_L2_V1 selected by preregistered LOMO rule; pooled held-out log loss 1.71898 vs B1a 1.86334; 10/11 meetings improved.

FAIL: 141/141 across five fresh meeting-disjoint meetings. NL1 log loss 1.80780 vs B1a 1.81426, improvement only 0.00646 < required 0.03; NL1 lower log loss in 2/5 meetings < required 3. Top1 and Top3 noninferiority passed. NL1 not promoted.
198/198 across six new meeting-disjoint meetings; both preregistered entropy/day directions failed.

exact_next_executable_actions: Append the completed NL1 development and failed untouched-validation experiments to the canonical experiment ledger.
Preregister a separate DEVELOPMENT_ONLY stability-oriented architecture lineage before fitting, explicitly declaring the failed NL1 validation races as newly exposed development evidence if used.
Use meeting-grouped/leave-one-meeting-out evaluation across exposed non-protected meetings and favor lower-variance anchored probability corrections over another unconstrained replacement.

progress_reason: Remains 98%. This is material negative evidence and closes NL1 as the current replacement candidate, but it does not complete probability/ranking science. A new separately preregistered lineage and fresh untouched validation are still required before advancement.
